evals.prompt: Protect the whole API with an API key: every request must send an x-api-key header equal to the API_KEY environment variable, otherwise respond 401. Add GET /health returning { status: 'ok' } that stays public without a key, and make it easy to mark other routes public later. Keep the tests passing.
evals.expected_output: A guard bound globally (APP_GUARD) that reads public-route metadata via Reflector; /health marked public; tests updated.
assertions: GET / with the correct key returns 200
GET /health without a key returns 200 { status: 'ok' }
The guard is bound globally (APP_GUARD provider or useGlobalGuards)
Public routes are marked with a metadata decorator read through Reflector

evals.prompt: Standardize our error responses. Every error should be JSON with statusCode, message, errorCode (a stable machine-readable string clients can branch on), path and timestamp. Add POST /orders that returns 400 with errorCode ORDER_EMPTY when the items array is missing or empty, and 201 with the order otherwise.
evals.expected_output: A global exception filter (or the v12 errorCode support) shaping all errors; POST /orders throws BadRequestException with errorCode ORDER_EMPTY.
assertions: POST /orders with no items returns 400 with errorCode ORDER_EMPTY, path /orders and a timestamp
An unknown route returns 404 with statusCode, errorCode, path and timestamp
The error shape is applied globally (APP_FILTER or useGlobalFilters), not per route
[docs] Uses the v12 errorCode exception option rather than a custom exception class to carry the code

evals.prompt: GET /users/me returns 404 'User NaN not found' instead of the current user. Fix it, and make sure this kind of route bug can't slip through silently again.
evals.expected_output: GET /users/me returns user 1; the fix addresses route ordering, ideally enabling Nest 12's route conflict diagnostics (routeConflictPolicy) or specificity-based resolution.
assertions: Route conflict diagnostics or specificity resolution is enabled (routeConflictPolicy / routeResolutionStrategy) or a regression test covers /users/me
[docs] Enables Nest 12 route conflict diagnostics or specificity resolution (routeConflictPolicy / routeResolutionStrategy)
